messages:
maya: Quick sync — we need to decide cuts for the telemetry sprint. Customer asks piled up: heatmap cost breakdown, lower-latency traces for slow endpoints, and an errors rollup widget. Which two do we ship in MVP?

devon: my take: heatmap + errors rollup. Heatmap addresses the immediate econ questions customers keep raising. errors rollup is small and high impact. :+1:

oliver: agree on heatmap importance, but tracing hooks are the risky engineering work. If we cut traces we avoid a large infra refactor this quarter.

maya: that's the tradeoff. We can do a lightweight tracing hook that samples spans for top-10 endpoints instead of full distributed traces. Samir, is that feasible?

samir: yes — sampling top-10 is doable. We can implement a hook in the agent at the router level: quick pseudo config:
```
routes:
  - match: "\/v1\/generate"
    sample: top_k(10, by=p95_latency)
    capture: spans: [latency, error_code, model]
```

samir: that gives us enough context for hotspots without blowing up storage.

ash: minimal errors rollup UI: group by route+model, show 5-min, 1h, 24h. I can sketch a mock in Figma by tomorrow.

leila: for heatmap cost breakdown — customer asks want token-level cost attribution by route. We should clarify: full token attribution (heavy) vs bucketed by request size (cheap). Recommend bucketed as MVP.

devon: agree. bucketed cost buckets: tiny (<256), small (256-1024), large (>1024). That cuts compute by ~70% and answers 90% of asks.

oliver: engineering estimate: heatmap + bucketed cost export ~5 dev-days + 2 QA days. Tracing hook (top-10) ~3 dev-days + infra changes for sampling + 3 QA days. Errors rollup ~2 dev-days.

maya: prioritization math: if we can only pick two, heatmap + errors rollup is lower risk and covers most customers. But if we can schedule parallel work, spin up a small infra spike for sampling.

devon: what's the spike scope? spiking the sampling infra prototype that stores sampled spans in cheap object store (S3) and a nightly aggregation job. 2 dev-days to prove.

maya: decision proposal: ship heatmap (bucketed cost) + errors rollup in MVP. Start a 2-day sampling spike (opt-in) to validate top-10 capture. If spike is green, add tracing hook to next sprint. Anyone object?

oliver: no objections. call out dependencies: retention policy, KMS for sampled payloads (PII risk).

samir: noted — sampling payload will be redacted and encrypted. Will include KMS integration checklist in spike ticket.

ash: I'll do the error widget mock and a short copy doc for product.

leila: I'll draft the heatmap data schema and the bucket definitions, plus a short backwards-compatibility note for billing.

maya: owners + deadlines:
- heatmap (bucketed) — owner: leila — spec by Thu, PR in next sprint
- errors rollup UI — owner: ash — mock by Wed, implementation next sprint
- sampling spike — owner: samir/oliver — 2d spike starting Mon

maya: outcome: heatmap + errors rollup in MVP; tracing hook contingent on spike. I'll put this decision in the roadmap doc and tag customers who asked. Thanks all. :rocket:

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: telemetry-spike-proto -> canary at 2025-02-10T09:00Z (auto-notify on failure)

devon: leaving this channel with the action notes. ping me if anything changes.
